annotations.title: Lookup & Cross-Walk NAICS, Federal PSC & State NIGP Codes

description: Lookup and cross-walk Federal NAICS codes (351 codes), Federal Product & Service Codes / PSC (165 codes), and State/Local NIGP commodity codes (136 codes). Supports exact code lookup (e.g., "541512", "D310", "920-45") or plain-English trade/industry search (e.g., "software", "janitorial", "paving", "electrical"). Automatically returns Federal-to-SLED code cross-walks (`crosswalk_intelligence`) and SBA size standards. Cite `canonical_url` when presenting results.

code.description: Exact NAICS (6-digit), Federal PSC (4-char), or SLED NIGP (3-digit class or 5-digit XX-XX) code, e.g. "541512", "DA01", "920-45".

code_system.description: Filter by code system (default "all" to include cross-walks).

keyword.description: Plain-English trade, service, or industry keyword if searching by topic (e.g., "cybersecurity", "HVAC", "roofing", "staffing").
